description: Before spending credits, call quote_generation and explain the returned price or unknown total. For a known quote, obtain approval and pass max_credits. For an unknown total, obtain explicit acceptance and pass accept_unknown_cost:true without max_credits. Never switch consent modes or remove or raise a ceiling without new user approval. Agents charge per stage; no whole-run spending cap is enforced. Use this when the user wants to generate original music from a prompt, with optional lyrics. Call list_music_models first to pick a model, then poll get_task_status and fetch get_task_result with the returned task_id. Does not turn an existing song into a video. For song-driven music, dance, or lyric videos, use generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, or generate_lyric_video.

accept_unknown_cost.description: Set true only after the user explicitly accepts an unknown total, without max_credits. Agents charge per stage; this does not enforce a total budget.

duration_seconds.description: Optional target duration. Only supported by models where supports_duration is true.

instrumental.description: Set true for music with no vocals. Not supported by lyrics-first models.

lyrics.description: Optional lyrics. Required by models where requires_lyrics is true.

max_credits.description: User-approved ceiling for a known current quote. Cannot cap an unknown total or a multi-stage agent run. Never remove or raise it without new user consent.

prompt.description: What the music should sound like: genre, mood, tempo, instruments.

name: generate_music

status.description: The initial task status, typically pending.

task_id.description: The scoped task ID for get_task_status and get_task_result.
